name: DS18B20
description: Waterproof-probe digital thermometer (1-Wire), one sensor per pin

temperature.description: Temperature in °C, at most 2 s old. A failed read returns the last good value: call temperature() first, then check is_connected() before acting on the value

is_connected.description: true if the last temperature() call got a valid answer (call it after temperature()); false if the sensor is missing, unplugged or the read was corrupt

tips: Power VDD from 3.3V; parasite power (VDD tied to GND) is not supported.
The 4.7kΩ pull-up between DQ and 3.3V is required; long cables may need 2.2kΩ.
One sensor per pin: give each extra probe its own GPIO.
Reads 85°C right after power-up before its first conversion; the driver rejects that value.

alternatives.name: BME280
alternatives.note: I²C, adds humidity and pressure; not for liquids.
